ops.title: install-desk-6 handoff Nov 7 5:25 AM
ops.body:
install-desk-6 handoff, Nov 7 5:25 AM PT. Mac lane, standing install desk for drive durable-agents-rebuild.

## State on the Mac (read)
- long-running pack 0.7.1975, lr 0.1258.1. Supervisor pid 40358, generation 727, serves 0.7.1975 in place. It holds cc-skills main through 857c256 (#3809, #3811, #3812, #3817, #3818, #3819, #3820).
- cci and cc-inbox 0.54.5 (b603107), daemon pid 50354. cc-slack 0.16.0 (#177): binary, plugin and daemon. cc-present 0.59.0 (#180): binary, plugin and daemon. ccx and cc-context 0.95.24 (b220ef1).
- The store desk runs inside the supervisor and re-execs with it, so a new store verb needs no restart.
- lr install exits 0 since #3819. Its list of desks still on an old process arrives as an `lr.note` record (589581).

## Sprites (read, roll-1975.out)
82 of 90 in scope run lr 0.1258.1. The 62 workers among them serve 0.7.1975; the 20 graders carry no pack.
- Unreached: dar-desk-3 (Storage not ready, then timeout) and pool-qkbexwkivqyiitx6 (cc-remote-codex-ask failed).
- Short on disk (an install needs 1024M free): pool-3z7fxozk2hzg7lxf, pool-4g7eke4w74to7ya6, pool-fgf7uye55boogp2t, pool-mkjizircrzsea54o (meta-desk-4's own Sprite) and pool-se6avb3k64rybxya. Delete nothing on them; their owners free space.
- pool-gdvo33hfm6y7efa7 failed at the capt-hookd 12.121.48 step with no reason printed. Not diagnosed.
- pool-26prrkx55iuqf3ll took the install, but the drive's entry and lr.json did not land (connection dropped). The next roll carries them.

## Open
1. meta-desk-4 ask 588617 (405165@00624701): #3817 is installed but not live. desk-creds keep, launchd com.long-running.durable-agents-rebuild.desk-creds, pid 17603, runs lr 0.862.1 (pack 0.7.1661) from Nov 5. Owner card card-desk-creds-keep-restart: https://poetic-technology.slack.com/archives/D0C4HQWPLCC/p1794052744219299. His answer wakes install-desk. On "Restart it now", restart only that job, then post to meta-desk which hosts keep's first push reached, and resolve 588617. A session cannot kickstart launchd (owner note b7ae238); read how the obs-desk restart was carried out (card-rmw5ce4xd) first.
2. obs desk pid 15839 on 0.7.1908 is also stale. No card drawn; meta-desk was told.
3. Old asks left open, not install requests: 494974 and 461008 (rotation and worker_done orders for earlier desks), 494566 (done records for merged PRs), 493575 (dar-desk-2 lr), 458114 (owner-relay re-render), 456017 (owner's bounds, parts 1 and 2), 441664 (grade-stall-kill proof).

## Scripts (~/.vcache/scratch/install-desk-6)
- install-at.zsh <commit> <long-running CI run> <lr release run>: waits for both runs, takes the newest pack tag, checks that it carries the commit, waits for CI on the tag's base, then runs lr install. The output is install-<ver>.out.
- cci-at.zsh <commit> <cc-inbox CI run>: cc-inbox release, then cci upgrade, cci serve, the plugin update and lr sprites pin.
- A roll is `lr sprites roll`; `--worker <sprite>` rolls one Sprite; `--skip a,b` leaves Sprites out.

## Lessons
- A cask upgrade (cc-slack, cc-present) deletes the old Caskroom directory. A process that resolved it mid-relink fails once (supervisor 586412), and an old `cc-slack watch` (pid 67483, under `lr owner watch`) keeps the deleted binary until its owner restarts it.
- `lr --version`, not `lr version`.
- ask-owner refuses lane names, counts in prose, and jargon: use plain words and a table.
